{{Quote|We request an audience with your leaders.''"<br />"''It'll be your funeral.|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]]|<ref name="EMN" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] '''traveled''' to the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to meet with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leaders with their new [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

==Prelude==
[[File:ShadowLeaders-Eminence.png|thumb|left|250px|Maul, Opress, Vizsla and the Death Watch arrived on Mustafar.]]
In the aftermath of their disastrous [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|duel]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] and a skirmish with pirate leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his pirate gang]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] fled the destruction of their ship in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The two, minus one cybernetic leg and arm respectively, soon lost consciousness in the pod.<ref name="Revival" /><ref name="EMN" />

Later, the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] found the pod and cut a hole to get inside. [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] entered to find the two brothers. Vizsla found [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|Maul's lightsaber]] and then had the two taken away for treatment.<ref name="EMN" />

When Maul awoke, Vizsla asked what the two were. Maul stated they were [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], and when Vizsla asked if the two worked for Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Maul stated that they served no one and that the two were brothers, the true lords of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. When he said that their ship had been destroyed by Kenobi, Vizsla and Maul concluded the two had a common enemy. The two allied with each other and plotted taking Mandalore for themselves. First, however, they were to rally the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="EMN" />

==The mission==
<div style="float:right">[[File:Blacksuncensored.png|thumb|right|250px|The decapitated bodies of the Black Sun leaders]]</div>
{{Quote|A battalion, brother.''"<br />"''They will serve us well.|[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="EMN" />}}
Upon their arrival on Mustafar, Maul, Opress, Vizsla, Bo-Katan and other Death Watch soldiers met with [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], who took them inside the facility to meet with [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]]. Moj believed that Maul and his allies stood no chance in recruiting Grunseit. Maul attempted to rally Grunseit to his cause, which Opress enforced by killing a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] guard, but Grunseit refused to ally with Maul and mocked him as well as his allies, so he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Opress, who hurled his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from across a table, which also killed Grunseit's four other leaders.<ref name="EMN" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|It would seem the decision to join us is now yours.''"<br />"''After careful consideration, we will join you.|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]]|<ref name="EMN" />}}
Following Grunseit's death, Ziton Moj willingly joined Maul's [[Shadow Collective/Legends|new army]]. The [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] at his disposal were absorbed into the Maul's alliance. They would prove instrumental for the subsequent [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] and [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|battle]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]].<ref name="EMN" /><ref name="SOR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>
